critical_code_review_comments: DeployPanel.jsx is 680 lines — borderline but acceptable for now; consider splitting ConfigForm/Toolbar/LogStream into sub-files if the panel grows further (file-size heuristic threshold >700).

Save config currently shows the backend 503 (vault_unavailable) detail dict serialized inside deploy-cfg-error — UX-wise the message is human-readable but the JSON-stringified detail.msg field is what surfaces; this works because the implementation extracts .detail.msg. Verified live: error renders the friendly msg.

Hybrid fallback contract is correctly implemented: GET /config/{pid} returns scope='project' when project row exists, scope='user' on fallback, configured=false when neither exists. Private key is never returned in cleartext (masked to '••••...').
POST /deploy/run with project_id correctly persists project_id on the run row and uses the project-scoped host; verified by unit test test_run_uses_project_scoped_cfg_when_project_id_given.
Limit clamping (≤100) on /deploy/runs verified at HTTP layer (request limit=999999 returns ≤100 rows).
